title: Lidar-detected pyramid in the Amazon

tellings.quote: um they have identified what their certain is an enormous pyramid wow in the middle of the Amazon rainforest

plain: A writer on lost ancient civilisations, Graham Hancock, said on a 2022 podcast that an archaeologist from the University of Exeter, in England, told him about a find in the Colombian Amazon. Using lidar, a laser scan from the air that can map the ground beneath the trees, the team is said to be sure it has found an enormous pyramid in the middle of the rainforest. If true, it would mean a large building culture once lived where people thought there was only jungle.
